tools.description: List services on the code402 gateway storefront (GET /v1/services): first-party APIs and third-party seller listings, each with method, URL, USDC price, and network. tools.name: code402_get_service
tools.description: Fetch a single service from the code402 storefront by its serviceId (as returned by code402_list_services). Returns the same service shape as code402_list_services, or an error naming close matches when the id is unknown.

tools.name: code402_probe_endpoint
tools.description: Send an unpaid GET to any public https URL and report whether it answers with a valid x402 402 challenge, plus normalized terms { scheme, network, amount (USDC base units), price (dollars), payTo, asset }. Use before budgeting a payment or to liveness-check a listing. No payment is ever sent. Privat

tools.name: code402_gateway_health
tools.description: Check the code402 gateway's /healthz: returns { status, service, network } where network is the settlement chain currently configured (e.g. base-sepolia or base).

tools.name: code402_register_seller
tools.description: Register a seller on the code402 gateway (or update its name — the payout wallet is immutable once set; re-binding requires EIP-191 proof): POST /v1/sellers with { id, wallet, name }. Payments for the seller's listings settle directly to this wallet (non-custodial). Registration is free; fees are 0.

tools.name: code402_create_listing
tools.description: Create or update a paid listing for a registered seller: POST /v1/sellers/{sellerId}/services with { serviceId, upstream_url, price_usd, method?, description? }. tools.name: code402_get_seller_analytics
tools.description: Fetch a seller's own settlement analytics (free): GET /v1/sellers/{sellerId}/analytics. Returns { total_settled_calls, gross_usd, unique_buyers, by_service: [{ service_id, calls }] }.

tools.name: code402_get_seller_invoice
tools.description: Compute a seller's platform-fee invoice from settled receipts: GET /v1/sellers/{sellerId}/invoice?since={unix_ms}. Returns { tier, transactions, gross_usdc_units, platform_fee_usdc_units, seller_net_usdc_units, fee_bps }. Amounts are integer USDC base units (6 decimals).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: code402_list_services, code402_probe_endpoint, code402_trust_check, code402_get_agent_reputation · Private data: code402_list_services, code402_probe_endpoint, code402_register_seller, code402_create_listing, code402_get_agent_reputation · Public sink: code402_probe_endpoint, code402_register_seller, code402_create_listing, code402_get_agent_reputation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: code402_list_services, code402_probe_endpoint, code402_trust_check, code402_get_agent_reputation · Private data: code402_list_services, code402_probe_endpoint, code402_register_seller, code402_create_listing, code402_get_agent_reputation · Public sink: code402_probe_endpoint, code402_register_seller, code402_create_listing, code402_get_agent_reputation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
